answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by tethering identity to biometric uniqueness, forcing a tide of computational capital into verifiable human registries. Without this barrier, an automated spiral of illicit accounts would degrade network utility. Each node must commit significant stake or verifiable physical presence, turning a would-be malicious sonnet of fake identities into an economically prohibitive venture where the cost to sybil exceeds any potential gain from network manipulation.
